messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired — INC PDI12345 — service: inference-gateway-prod — High 5xx error rate detected (5xx = 8.2%, baseline ~0.6%). Paging on-call primary. Runbook: https://runbook.redwood.internal/inference/5xx-throttle — check logs, scale, and routing.

alice: ACK — I'm on it. grabbing logs and runbook.

incident-bot: Acknowledged by alice at 1787654330

bob: seen something like this last week, mem pressure -> liveness flaps. checking pods in us-west1 now.

alice: quick tail shows a lot of `504 upstream read timeout` and `503 backend overloaded`. sample: ```2026-03-17T03:12:45Z inference-gateway us-west1 pod-42 503 "backend: grpc error: code = Unavailable"```

jen: flagging infra — I'll scale worker pool +2 nodes immediately (kubectl scale).

infra-bot: Scale request accepted: deploy/inference-worker -> replicas 6. rollout started.

carol: routing team: diverting 10% traffic to dedicated fallback pool (dedicated-1) while we stabilize. applying now.

alice: running smoke tests — embeddings calls failing for several customers, some timeouts. contacting CS for impacted tenant list.

bob: temp mitigation: increase proxy keepalive to 30s and disable prefetch logic. applying in us-west1. /cc @ops

ops: acknowledged; keepalive change rolled out to us-west1 proxies. initial metrics: 5xx dropped 8.2% -> 3.1% within ~2m :eyes:

alice: we should consider rollback of last model-sidecar canary — that rolled out ~10m ago and timeline matches.

jen: initiating rollback of model-sidecar in us-west1 to v2.14 now. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PDI12345

carol: confirming warmup on dedicated-1 cache and KV priming started.

incident-bot: Incident update: scaling + rollback + proxy keepalive change in progress. Next automated check-in in 5m. Severity set to SEV2.

bob: monitoring dashboards — error rate trending down across pods, tail latency improving. will keep a close watch for 15m. :thumbsup:

alice: customer impact estimate: ~0.4% of total requests returned 5xx (roughly 12k requests in last 10m). CS pinged to notify affected tenants.

carol: routing confirmed: no increased errors on dedicated-1 after warmup. KV cache warming showing hit rate +22%.

ops: rolling checks green. recommend keeping increased capacity for 30m then gradual scale-down.

jen: adding runbook note: likely TTL expiry storm causing cascade of cache misses and backend pressure. propose TTL-smoothing and softer expiry ramp.

alice: agreed — will own postmortem and action items (RCA + TTL smoothing + better prewarm).

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and under mitigation. Will auto-update if metrics cross thresholds.

alice: thanks everyone, marking thread for post-incident ticket creation once stable. :heart:
